title: Daily or Anytime: what would you like to play?
practice: Try today’s main Daily. If you fancy more, choose one optional extra.

sections.html:
Want a fresh challenge chosen for you? Head to Daily. Have a particular topic in mind? Browse the Anytime games and pick whatever catches your eye.

You can start playing without an account. If you want to keep your progress across devices, sign in through My Stats. Guest results can also appear in the rankings, under a generated alias.
sections.title: Two ways to get started

sections.html:
The Daily starts with one main game, shared by everyone that day. Finish it to keep your streak. Tomorrow might bring a word puzzle, a quick calculation or a set of questions.

Fancy another round? Choose one of the two optional extras. The main game can earn up to 2,500 Daily points; the extra adds up to 1,000. Skipping the extra does not affect your streak, and opening one fixes your choice for the day.

Past Daily rounds are practice. To keep today’s streak, play today’s main game.
sections.title: One Daily, with room for one more

sections.html:
Try World Flags if you like recognising designs, World Capitals for a geography challenge, or General Knowledge for a bit of everything. Where difficulty levels are available, choose one that feels enjoyable and gives you room to improve.

For a change of pace, explore the word and number games. Each has its own rules; a quick look at the guide can help you settle in before the timer starts.
sections.title: Follow your interests with Anytime

sections.html:
Perhaps a flag caught your attention, or an answer reminded you of something you would like to know more about. Follow a related article or try another topic.

Want some friendly competition? Send a Daily challenge to a friend, compare your main-game scores and keep the answers to yourself until you have both played.
sections.title: See where a round takes you

sections.html:
One Daily game can be enough. Or pick an Anytime quiz on a favourite topic and see where it takes you.

BrainiLab+ is optional. It does not provide extra points, attempts or ranking advantages. The membership page explains the current benefits; an upgrade is not required to play.
